statement: Once the node co-signs a settlement or collateral-to-reserve it proposes no new frames on that Account until the operation lands on chain or is superseded: the signature commits to the epoch and the nonce, not to the off-chain height, so frames signed after it would be lost when it lands. The Arrival cell holds the receiving half on spec/account/frames.scm: a frozen replica refuses every peer frame with a retryable frozen refusal, and while a settlement is signed its fold equals the head's off-chain offdelta (bug frozen-accepts, config freeze); that the frozen proposer stays silent has no planted bug on the page, and the signature's commitment to the epoch and nonce is on no page.
